description: List the watches you ALREADY have — a read-only view, it does NOT check for new filings. Returns JSON with each watch's mark, classes, threshold, schedule, created/last-checked dates, total alerts so far, and the most recent new hits. Use this to see what you are watching; use check_watches to actually run a check for new filings right now. Private to one email — pass the email and the 6-digit code from request_watch_code, or a session token from a previous verification. No email addresses are ever returned.

code.description: 6-digit code from request_watch_code, for the email above

sessionToken.description: 60-minute watch session token from a previous verification

name: list_watches
